# EchoAgent Runtime package template

This directory contains packaging metadata retained by the embedded EchoAgent
Agent Runtime. EchoAgent Desktop is distributed from the
[EchoAgent Desktop repository](https://github.com/fuyuxiang/echo-agent-desktop).

The repository does not currently publish a standalone npm runtime package.
Build and validation instructions are available in the
[vendored runtime README](../../../../../README.md).

EchoAgent Desktop configures model providers through its BYOK settings and
manages application updates through the Tauri updater.
